praise.name: Ammaan
praise.description: Ku bilowda saacadaha tukashadaada adiga ammaanaya Rabbiga. Isaga ku ammaan waxyaalaha hadda maanka ku haya. Isaga ku ammaan hal gaar ah oo uu noloshadaada sameeyay todobaadkii la soo dhaafay. Isaga ku ammaan wanaagsanaantiisa qoyskiinna.

wait.name: Sug
wait.description: Waqti ku qaato adiga sugaya Rabbiga. Aamusnow oo u oggolow inuu fikirrada idinka u soo ururiyo.

confess.name: Qir
confess.description: Weydii Ruuxa Quduuska ah inuu ku tuso wax kasta oo noloshadaada ku jira oo isaga ka xumayn kara. Weydii inuu u fiiro geeyo dabeecadaha qaldan iyo ficillada gaarka ah oo aadan weli tukashada qirashada u samayn. Hadda Rabbiga u qir si aad u daahirnaato.

read_the_word.name: Akhri Erayga
read_the_word.description: Waqti ku qaato adiga akhriya Sabuurrada, nebiyada, ama qaybo ku saabsan tukashada ee Axdiga Cusub.

pray_the_word.name: Tukasho Erayga
pray_the_word.description: Tukasho qaybo gaar ah. Tukashooyinka Kitaabka Quduuska ah iyo Sabuuro badan ayaa si fiican ugu habboon ujeedadan.

thank.name: Mahad
thank.description: Rabbiga ugu mahad naq waxyaalaha noloshadaada ku jira, qoyskiinna daraaddood, iyo kaniisaddiinna daraaddood.

sing.name: Gabay
sing.description: Heeso ammaan ama cibaadate ama gabayo kale ama gabayo ruuxi ah ku heeso.

meditate.name: Ka Feker
meditate.description: Rabbiga ka codso inuu kula hadlo. Qalin iyo warqad diyaar u haysato si aad u duubto aragtiyaha uu ku siiyo.

listen.name: Dhegayso
listen.description: Waqti ku qaato adiga isku daraya waxyaalaha aad akhriday, waxyaalaha aad u tukashooday iyo waxyaalaha aad heeseysay oo arag sida Rabbiga u wada keeno oo uu kula hadlo.

praise_end.name: Ammaan
praise_end.description: Rabbiga u ammaan waqtigii aad isaga la qaadatay iyo aragtiyihii uu ku siiyay. Isaga u ammaan sifooyinkiisa ammaanta leh.

aria.next_step: U gudub tallaabada tukashada ee xigta
aria.restart_cycle: Dib uga bilow wareegga tukashada bilowga

audio.title: Codka
audio.description: Ciyaar codad jilicsan marka la wareegayo talaaboyinka salaadda

screen.title: Shaashadda
screen.keep_awake: Ilaali shaashadda oo toosan inta salaadda ah
screen.description: Ka hor-tag shaashadda in ay mugnaato ama damiso inta ku dhex jirta shirarka salaadda
screen.not_supported: Xirashada toosinta shaashadda looma taageero biraawsarkan
